$comment: Known incompatibilities between captured releases and current source, found by the compatibility matrix (docs/tactical/359-mixed-version-compatibility-matrix.md). Tests accept exactly these items for these captures and fail on anything else. Each entry records a maintainer decision: fix, or accept until the releases leave the support window.

breaks.impact: Tracker timing moved from ages to instants anchored on UpdateBatch.server_now_millis in 0.3.1. Current clients default server_now_millis and fill the instants with null for these hosts (tracker timing shows as unknown). Extension 1.1.3 requires the age fields and rejects current hosts' tracker views.
breaks.decision: Accepted: the instants show as unknown for desktop 0.3.0 and android 1.0.28 until they leave the support window, and extension 1.1.5 replaces 1.1.3.

breaks.impact: download_all_pending_add (Download all on a pending add) is new since these hosts, which close the connection on it. Released hosts advertise no capabilities.
breaks.decision: Fixed in the client, 2026-10-15: a host whose hello has no product and whose batches omit server_now_millis is one of these, and LiveApplication sends confirm_pending_file_selection with every file selected instead, once the file list has loaded (R1 checks the request). The schema-level entry stays while these releases are captured.

breaks.impact: Android 1.0.29 ignores disable_future, so "don't ask again" is not saved there.
breaks.decision: Accepted until android 1.0.29 leaves the support window: only the preference is lost, and its hello cannot be told apart from later released hosts.

breaks.impact: disable_future is ignored by android 1.0.29; desktop 0.3.0 and android 1.0.28 receive the fallback instead.
breaks.decision: Accepted with the client-sent entry above.

breaks.impact: extension 1.1.3 validates host data strictly and rejects the stop-limit settings a host built from current main sends, so the companion cannot open its library. This is the release hold in clients/web/src/api/release-compatibility.json: hosts must not ship these additions until a tolerant extension has replaced it.
breaks.decision: release hold; resolved by publishing extension 1.1.5 before a host release
